title: MILO Marathon Tagbilaran Leg 2026 Review: Bohol Qualifier
seo_title: MILO Marathon Tagbilaran 2026 Review | Bohol Philippines
meta_description: National MILO Marathon 2026 Tagbilaran Leg: September 13. RUNRIO's series qualifier in Bohol — Chocolate Hills province.
dek: Set for 13 September 2026 in Tagbilaran City, Bohol, this RUNRIO-produced MILO Marathon qualifying leg brings the series to the Chocolate Hills province.
verdict: The MILO Marathon Tagbilaran Leg is a RUNRIO-produced MILO series qualifier in Tagbilaran City — the capital of Bohol, home to the Chocolate Hills, tarsier sanctuaries, and the Loboc River. Five distances from 1K to 21K. RUNRIO's production ensures professional standards. September in Bohol is the transition season. A MILO series qualifier in one of the Philippines' most celebrated tourist destinations.
